annotations.title: Calculate a chart from a place or coordinates

description: SHOW THE BIRTH CHART. Use when the person wants to see their chart, planet positions, Navamsa or running dasha. Returns a compact readable summary (Lagna, planet table, current Vimshottari, birth Panchanga, Navamsa) and, in hosts that support MCP Apps, an interactive South Indian Rasi/Navamsa chart with a dasha timeline. For interpretation of a question use consult_jyotishya instead. Calculates a complete South Indian chart from a known catalogue place or explicit latitude, longitude, and IANA timezone supplied by the MCP host. Bare place names auto-resolve to the curated best-effort match with alternatives noted. This deterministic tool never invokes another AI model.
name: calculate_chart_from_known_place
title: Calculate a chart from a place or coordinates
